resources.string: For people you fully trust. Your helper hears what your phone says and controls it from theirs, with Tiresias: they can adjust the phone, set up Tiresias or recover an app. You hear everything and can stop it whenever you want.
If your helper is on your same Wi-Fi, read them this code: %1$s. They type it in their Tiresias, in Remote help, “Type the code”.
See the code for the same Wi-Fi
I could not get help ready. Check that you have internet.
There is no internet. Connect to Wi-Fi or turn on mobile data to ask for help.
I could not get help ready. Try again.
Remote help needs Tiresias to be on in this phone

%1$s is asking for help with their phone from Tiresias. If you have it installed, you will get a notice to help with one tap. If not, share this message with Tiresias. Valid for %2$d minutes. Code: %3$s
Choose how to send the help invitation
The help invitation could not be sent
Sending the help request through WhatsApp
Help request sent to %1$s. Wait for them to join.
Help request sent to %1$s by SMS. Wait for them to join.
The message is written: press Send to send the help request
%1$s wants to help you from their phone. Do you allow it?
%1$s is helping you from their phone. They hear what your phone says and can control it. To finish, hold both volume keys.
The connection with %1$s was lost. If they do not come back in two minutes, the help ends by itself.
%1$s is helping you from their phone
%1$s has finished helping. Nobody is controlling your phone now.
Time is up for help from %1$s. Nobody is controlling your phone now.
%1$s has finished helping you. Nobody is controlling your phone now.
The phone is locked: the person has to unlock it
The other phone’s screen has turned off
The other phone’s screen has turned on
That cannot be done through remote help
There is no text field selected in the other phone
That element is no longer on screen: ask for the list again
Waiting for your helper. They may only reach you on the same Wi-Fi.
Waiting for your helper, wherever they are

When someone asks you for help, their invitation reaches you by WhatsApp or SMS and Tiresias shows a notification to help with one tap. You can also share the message with Tiresias, copy it and paste it here, or type its code.
The TIR1 code or the 8 digits for the same Wi-Fi
There is no Tiresias help invitation in what you copied
The invitation has expired: ask the person to send it again
SMS (sent by itself with the SMS permission)
Name of this phone in the help
What your helper calls you, for example Mum
Also ask me before letting trusted people in
If you turn this off, you will be told and have a few seconds to stop it. Anyone else is always asked about.
Ask the router to let them in from outside
Asks your home router to let your helper through (UPnP or NAT-PMP) during the help. If the router refuses, nothing goes wrong: other routes are tried.
Remind that you are being helped every %1$d minutes
Remind that you are being helped: never
Remind that you are being helped
Nearby devices permission (local network), for the same Wi-Fi
Permission to send SMS by itself
Notifications permission, for the help notice
Without that permission, that part does not work

The phones first try to reach each other directly. If they cannot, for example with mobile data on both, they link through the Tor network, opening nothing and with no server of ours: it takes a minute longer to connect and each command takes almost a second. Everything is encrypted end to end. Banking apps and codes do not go through the help.
First end your own help request
The connection was lost: trying again
Could not reach the other phone. Ask them to request help again, or phone them.
The person did not let you in. If you are not on their trusted list, they must allow it first in their Tiresias.
The other person ended the help
Control the other phone with my gestures
Your Tiresias gestures go to the other phone. To come back to yours, the action “Control the other phone with my gestures” or both volume keys.
Read their screen from the top
There are no elements on their screen
It is typed where their cursor is
Information about one of their apps
Search for an app in their store
Open a link on their phone
Hear the other phone’s voice again
The other phone’s voice is heard again
There is no connection with the other phone now
Your gestures are back on your phone

Control a PC with NVDA or Tiresias for Windows from the phone, with the braille surface: you hear the PC with the Tiresias voice. On the PC, in NVDA, Remote Access (or the NVDA Remote add-on), “Allow this computer to be controlled”, with the same server and key. It is encrypted up to the server, but the server can see what happens: use a trusted one or the direct connection to your PC.
In the channel, but the PC is not there: in NVDA, allow it to be controlled with the same key
There is no nvdaremote link in what you copied
nvdaremote.com, your own server or the PC’s IP (with :port if it is not 6837)
Type a text on the PC
It is pasted where the PC cursor is
Paste on the PC what was copied on the phone
Save the key too? It is stored encrypted on the phone.
The braille surface needs Tiresias to be on
The server certificate cannot be checked
The certificate of %1$s cannot be checked (your own server or a direct connection to a PC). Its fingerprint is %2$s. Trust it only if it is yours.
The connection with the PC was lost
There is more than one PC with that key: it would not be clear which one is talking
The server uses another version of remote access
The PC sent text to the phone clipboard

PC braille surface, control mode: letters are keys; dots 6, 5, 3 and 2 on their own prepare Control, Alt, Shift and NVDA; one finger, the arrows; two fingers down, Enter; up, Escape. Three fingers up switch to the braille keyboard; down, the menu. Both volume keys remove the surface.
That combination is not a key
Paste on the PC what was copied on the phone
Mute the PC voice on the phone
The PC voice is heard again
The clipboard cannot be read from here: use “Paste on the PC what was copied” on the Control a PC screen
When locking the phone with a PC connected
The braille surface needs Android 11 or later

Braille web navigation. Type a letter to go to the next one: h heading, k link, b button, e field, f form, x checkbox, l list, t table, d region, g image; with capital, to the previous one. One finger sideways, next or previous; two fingers down, activate; two up, leave.
A letter jumps to its type; one finger sideways moves; two fingers down activate; two up leave
Braille search among the screen elements. Type part of a name; one finger down and up go through the results; three fingers sideways search among the apps; two fingers down open it; two up, leave.
It is no longer on screen
Type to search; one finger down and up go through; two fingers down open; two up leave
Voice in calls with its own volume
During a call, the Tiresias voice and sounds at their own percentage, so they do not blast when you turn the call up. With a finger on the screen, the volume keys change it.
With “Voice in calls” on: if you turn the call up or down, the voice is corrected the other way to sound the same
For each one, whether it is a speaker (the voice stays on the phone) or headphones

With the voice output on “System”, if music plays through a device marked as a speaker, the Tiresias voices play on the phone and not all over the room. Other voices and the sounds follow the system. Nothing changes during calls.
Grant the nearby devices permission to see the paired ones
There are no paired or connected Bluetooth devices
Asks Gemini to also describe what is not for all audiences (photos, messages). When off, Gemini may refuse.
The phone is in airplane mode. Turn it off so help can reach you.
I could not get help ready. Shall I phone %1$s?
%1$s is helping you from their phone. To finish, hold both volume keys.
%1$s is offering to help you with your phone. Do you allow it?
I am offering to help with your phone. If you have Tiresias, you will get a notice. Code: %1$s
%1$s is about to come into your phone to help you. If you do not want that, hold both volume keys.
Nobody new can come in during a call. If someone is asking you to do this over the phone, hang up and call your family.
Someone who is not on your trusted list tried to come in. I did not let them.
%1$s wants to help you from their phone. It is the first time. Only allow it if they are family and you asked them. Do you allow it?
Do you fully trust %1$s? If you say yes, your phone will recognise them next time.
%1$s has not come in yet. I am still waiting.
%1$s has not come in. What shall I do?
This is a banking or payment app: your helper cannot hear or control it until you leave it.
They have opened a banking or payment app: help is paused until they leave it. You can only take them to Home.
They have left the banking app: help continues
They have no help contact set: the phone cannot call by itself

resources.string: Keep it as it is now
Go back to how it was
Only they can help you. The first one is added during their first help. For another, you must ask for it here and wait 24 hours: that way nobody can rush you into it over the phone.
Remove %1$s? They will no longer be able to help you.
A new person will be able to come in after 24 hours. If someone is asking you to do this over the phone, do not: hang up and call your family. Continue?
A new person can come in from: %1$s
An invitation alone is not enough to come in: this protects you from phone scams. Only turn it off if you know what you are doing.
Use the Tor network if needed
So help can reach you even on mobile data or from another home, without opening anything on the router. It only runs during the help.
If they do not come in, also ask: %1$s
Leave empty to not use it
%1$s has made you a trusted person
Connecting to %1$s through the Tor network. It may take a minute or two.
Your phone does not need a screen reader. The other phone works by speech: a blind person does not touch the screen as you do, but goes through its items one by one. These buttons do the same.
You will see here what their phone says.
The last things their phone said:\n%1$s
Their details have not arrived yet
Tell them something through their phone
Their phone will say it aloud
